name: Trackpad Edge Volume Control
description: Adjust system or app audio volume by sliding a finger along the extreme right edge of the built-in or Magic Trackpad.

technical_details.permissions: None required (no macOS Accessibility / Input Monitoring permissions needed)

name: Trackpad Corner Tap Actions
description: Trigger media playback actions by tapping in the extreme bottom-left and bottom-right corners of the trackpad.

technical_details.bottom_right_corner: x >= 0.995 or within 2.5mm, y <= 0.15 (2 taps = Next Track, 3 taps = Previous Track)
technical_details.bottom_left_corner: x <= 0.005 or within 2.5mm, y <= 0.15 (2 taps = Play/Pause, 3 taps = Toggle Lyrics HUD)
technical_details.customizability: Remappable to 16 distinct actions in Settings > Gestures

name: Dual Volume Modes (System vs Focus)
description: Allows user to choose whether volume controls manipulate macOS CoreAudio Master Volume or Mooziac App Internal Volume independently.

technical_details.system_sound: Controls CoreAudio master device output via AudioObjectSetPropertyData
technical_details.focus_audio: Controls WebKit audio and AVPlayer internal gain without changing Mac master volume

name: Menu Bar Volume Scrolling
description: Scroll on top of the Mooziac menu bar icon to adjust volume up or down in discrete increments.

technical_details.step_increments: 6pt continuous trackpad scroll = 2% volume step; discrete mouse notch = 4% volume step
technical_details.filtering: Filters out inertia momentum scroll to avoid unintended runaway volume shifts

name: Loudness Normalization
description: Standardizes playback loudness across disparate tracks to prevent jarring volume jumps.

technical_details.transition: Smooth 250ms cosine volume easing between tracks

name: Audio Route Disconnect Protection
description: Automatically pauses playback when headphones or external audio outputs disconnect.

technical_details.action: Triggers immediate pause when audio route changes away from active headphones/AirPods

name: YouTube Music Integration
description: Native WebKit container rendering YouTube Music with ad-blocking scripts, native styling, and bridge hooks.

technical_details.engine: WebKit WKWebView with isolated data store
technical_details.user_agent: Modern Safari desktop User-Agent to bypass Google sign-in restrictions
technical_details.script_injection: Custom JS bridge hooks for playback events, track metadata, and DOM cleanup

name: YouTube Music Account & Library Sync
description: Allows logging in with Google account to access personal playlists, Liked Songs, recommendations, and listening history.

technical_details.storage: WKWebsiteDataStore persistent cookie jar stored in ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/WebKit/
technical_details.security: Zero credentials stored in plaintext; all OAuth sessions handled securely by Google WebKit session

name: Offline Audio Downloads
description: Download tracks from YouTube Music for offline local playback with embedded artwork and metadata.

technical_details.helper_binary: yt-dlp standalone universal binary managed in ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/bin/yt-dlp
technical_details.format: High-quality AAC/M4A or OPUS extraction with automated ID3/MP4 metadata tagging

name: Automated Helper Dependency Manager
description: Silently downloads, verifies, and updates yt-dlp binary without requiring Homebrew or Python on user system.

name: High-Fidelity Local Audio Playback
description: Play local audio files directly from Finder or local library folder with zero quality loss.

technical_details.bitrate: Bit-perfect rendering up to 24-bit / 192kHz supported by DAC

name: Local SQLite Library & History Database
description: Fast SQLite-backed storage for cached tracks, custom playlists, liked songs, and listening history.

technical_details.indexing: Indexed by filepath, track_id, and played_at timestamp

name: Multi-Tier Synced Lyrics Engine
description: Fetches, aligns, caches, and scrolls synchronized lyrics line-by-line during playback.

technical_details.tier_0: Local sidecar .lrc files in same folder and ~/Music/Mooziac/
technical_details.tier_0_8: YouTube Music InnerTube synchronized lyrics endpoint
technical_details.tier_1_3: LRCLib REST API (exact match -> search query -> title fuzzy match)

name: Centered Menu Bar / Notch Lyrics HUD
description: Floating borderless HUD window docked directly beneath the MacBook notch or top menu bar displaying synchronized lyrics.

technical_details.positioning: Screen center aligned horizontally, top offset pinned right below menu bar
technical_details.rendering: Auto-scrolling current line highlighting with smooth alpha fade on past lines

name: Native Discord Rich Presence
description: Broadcasts currently playing song title, artist, album art, and live elapsed time to your Discord profile.

technical_details.ipc_transport: Pure Swift Unix domain socket /tmp/discord-ipc-0 through /tmp/discord-ipc-9
technical_details.dependencies: Zero external Node.js or Python daemons

name: macOS Now Playing & Control Center
description: Integrates with macOS Control Center, lock screen media widget, and hardware media keys.

technical_details.center: MPNowPlayingInfoCenter with artwork, title, artist, elapsed time, duration, and playback rate
technical_details.commands: MPRemoteCommandCenter for Play, Pause, Toggle, Next, Previous, and Scrubber seek

name: Menu Bar Mini Player & Status Item
description: Compact menu bar status item showing play/pause status, track name scrolling marquee, and quick controls popup.

technical_details.scrolling_volume: Direct scroll events adjust volume without opening popup
technical_details.popup_menu: Quick access to playback toggles, next/prev, track info, lyrics toggle, settings, and quit

name: Menu Bar Only Mode (Hide Dock Icon)
description: Option to run Mooziac purely in the menu bar with the macOS Dock icon hidden.

name: OLED Dark Mode Theme
description: True pure black (#000000) high-contrast theme designed for MacBook Liquid Retina XDR and external OLED monitors.

technical_details.background: #000000 solid true black, zero pixel illumination in inactive regions

name: Adaptive Ambient Theme
description: Dynamically samples prominent color palettes from the current track's album art to produce an ambient visual glow.

technical_details.color_extraction: CoreGraphics palette analyzer extracting dominant, primary, and secondary hues
technical_details.macos27_fix: Enforces .dark tone for settings panel to avoid semantic contrast washouts

name: Pure Crystal Glass Theme
description: Sleek translucent frosted glass aesthetic with subtle 1.2px border rim highlight.

technical_details.materials: NSVisualEffectView with custom CGColor rim stroke (#B3B8B5 1.2px)

name: Watery Pure Transparent Theme
description: Ultra-lightweight vibrant blur background blending seamlessly with your macOS desktop wallpaper.

technical_details.materials: Full NSVisualEffectView behind window content with high transparency

name: Waveform Progress Bar
description: 32-bar reactive audio wave visualization that animates during playback and responds to scrubbing.

technical_details.bars: 32 discrete vertical bars drawn via CoreGraphics
technical_details.animation: Timer-based reactive height modulation scaled with track progress

name: Neon Glow Progress Bar
description: Sleek liquid progress capsule with a vibrant glowing blur trailing the playhead.

technical_details.shadow: NSShadow gaussian glow filter with dynamic track color tint

name: Cyber Dots Progress Bar
description: Retro LED dot matrix progress scrubber inspired by vintage hardware hi-fi displays.

technical_details.matrix: Discrete circular dot array illuminated proportionally to elapsed playback time

name: Minimal Line Progress Bar
description: Ultra-thin, zero-overhead precision scrub line for distraction-free listening and maximum battery life.

technical_details.rendering: Single-path 2px stroke, zero timer-driven CPU draw overhead

name: Queue Management & Reordering
description: Interactive queue panel supporting track reordering via drag & drop, clearing upcoming songs, shuffle, and repeat modes.

technical_details.modes: Repeat Off, Repeat All, Repeat One; Shuffle toggle

name: In-App Software Update Checker
description: Checks GitHub releases API for newer versions of Mooziac and alerts user with release notes and direct download.

technical_details.interval: Checked on application launch and via 'Check for Updates' menu item

name: Zero-Telemetry Local Privacy
description: Absolute user privacy by design with no trackers, no analytics, no external third-party telemetry servers.

technical_details.telemetry: Zero tracking SDKs embedded in binary
technical_details.local_storage: All history, playlists, liked songs remain exclusively in local SQLite database

name: Customizable Global Hotkeys GUI
description: Graphical user interface in Settings to customize and re-bind all global keyboard shortcuts.

technical_details.notes: Currently global shortcuts are fixed (e.g. Cmd+Opt+Space, Cmd+Shift+L). GUI hotkey recorder is an open feature request.

name: Playlist Export to M3U8 / JSON
description: Ability to export locally created Mooziac playlists to standard .m3u8 or .json playlist files for use in other media players.

technical_details.notes: Playlists are currently stored in local SQLite database. Direct file export is requested on GitHub.

name: Custom Accent Color for OLED Mode
description: Color wheel / hex input in Settings to customize the accent highlight color when using OLED Dark Mode.

technical_details.notes: OLED mode currently uses a fixed high-contrast neon white accent. User customizable hex color requested.

name: 10-Band Graphic Equalizer with Presets
description: Parametric or 10-band graphic equalizer with bass boost, vocal booster, and custom curve presets.

technical_details.notes: Mooziac currently features Loudness Normalization (-14 LUFS) and bit-perfect playback, but lacks an EQ slider bank. Highly requested by audiophile users.

name: Native Last.fm / ListenBrainz Scrobbler
description: Built-in direct API client for Last.fm and ListenBrainz scrobbling without requiring third-party system scrobbler utilities.

technical_details.notes: Currently scrobbling works indirectly via macOS MPNowPlayingInfoCenter third-party watchers (like Neptunes). Native OAuth client requested.

name: Integrated ID3 / Vorbis Tag Editor
description: In-app editor allowing users to modify track title, artist, album, genre, year, and embedded artwork for local audio files.

technical_details.notes: Mooziac currently only parses and reads metadata via AVMetadataItem; modifying audio container tags requires external tools like Kid3.
